title: Blackbox vibration analyzer in the core
goal: The core analyzes a blackbox log without storing it
acceptance: The F-005 core parses a blackbox CSV and returns the vibration report (axis spectra, motor summary, candidates) with behaviour identical to NERV's src/blackbox.ts; it stores nothing; specs carried over from NERV's test/blackbox.test.ts with invented logs
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
Owner data, export files and ID maps never enter Git

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: a 325-line pure module and its test, moved as is. Not a measurement.
